outer_splits: repository-provided five-fold gene-disjoint nested CV; test pairs have both endpoints in held-out genes and training pairs use only training genes
immune_scope: at least one endpoint in the nine predeclared immunotherapy signatures
coexpression: Spearman correlation over 239 independent pretreatment immunotherapy samples; response labels unused
classifier: class-weighted linear logistic head; fixed hyperparameters
recovered_edge_definition: true immune positive in the Txn_Jatin top score decile within its outer fold but outside the co-expression top score decile
